description:
Problem: nothing lets unreleased docs land ahead of a release, nothing proves the pin still matches a published release, and nothing reports that core released while the docs still show the old release. Outcome: a `next` branch workflow that CI understands, a pin check in `ci`, a nightly reminder, and written instructions.

Change:
1. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: also run on `push` to `next`. When the pull request base is `next` or the pushed ref is `next`, set `DOCS_INPUTS` to the fetched bundle directory (`.site-inputs`) for every job that assembles, checks or builds docs; otherwise leave it unset so the pin is used. Add `npm run docs:pin -- --check` (online, in the job that has a token) so `ci` fails on a tampered pin or a pin whose tag is not a published release. Keep the required check name `ci` and its `needs` complete.
2. `.github/workflows/nightly.yml`: add a job, in the existing style (label created with --force, one open issue updated by comment), that runs `npm run docs:pin -- --pending` and opens or updates the issue labelled `docs-release-pending` when core's latest release is newer than the pin.
3. `AGENTS.md` and `deploy/README.md`: replace the statements that the landing token and generated pages come from the bundle; describe the pin, `DOCS_INPUTS`, the `next` branch (unreleased docs merge to `next`; fixes to released docs merge to `main` and are merged forward into `next` with a merge commit; a release is `npm run docs:pin -- vX.Y.Z` on `next` then one pull request `next` into `main`; after that squash merge, `next` is brought level by merging `main` into it), and the nightly reminder. Plain English, no session or tracker references.

Contract with the docs build work: the override variable is exactly `DOCS_INPUTS`; unset means `release-pin/`. Do not implement the resolver here.

Constraints: workflows keep pinned action SHAs and least permissions; `deploy.yml` needs no DOCS_INPUTS and must not gain one (production always builds from the pin). No new workflow file.
